shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin maintains its position above $80,000 despite recent spot ETF outflows and investor profit-taking after a major rally.
Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are elevating market risks, leading some investors to treat Bitcoin as a potential hedge.
Robust US employment data has fueled concerns regarding Federal Reserve rate hikes, which may pressure liquidity in the crypto market.
A decline in Bitcoin dominance suggests that a rotation into altcoins may be starting.
Legislative progress on the Clarity Act and new SEC rules for on-chain finance are providing regulatory tailwinds for the industry.
